description: Send an invitation email so a new person can join the caller's organization with a chosen role. Returns the pending member record.

email.description: Email of the person to invite. They get a signup link.

name.description: Optional display name for the invitee.

role_id.description: UUID of the role to assign on accept. Get UUIDs from `list_org_roles`.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for the invitee, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'. Default: UTC.

name: invite_user
title: Invite User
